stemMd: Why was the earliest detailed survey an imperfect record of a prehuman landscape?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It was drawn after all vegetation vanished.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It was older than the pollen record.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Its authors had never visited the island.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It followed decades of grazing that had helped shape the grasslands.

explanationMd: The second paragraph explains that the survey postdated grazing and that the recorded openness partly reflected that activity. Detailed documentation therefore did not guarantee a landscape untouched by people.

distractorRationale.b: The pollen evidence suggested an earlier woodland state.
